refnamediv.refpurpose: Schur algorithm for computing reflection coefficients and prediction error variance.

listitem.para: Autocorrelation vector or matrix. If `R` is a matrix, the function computes the reflection coefficients
Reflection coefficients (matrix). Each column corresponds to the reflection coefficients for the respective column of `R`.
Prediction error variance (vector). Each row corresponds to the prediction error variance for the respective column of `R`.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `schurrc` function computes the reflection coefficients and prediction error variance using Schur's algorithm. If the input `R` is a matrix, the function processes each column independently.
